def can_tile_board(n, board):
    free_cells = sum(row.count('.') for row in board)
    return 'YES' if free_cells % 5 == 0 else 'NO'

input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()
n = int(data[0])
board = data[1:]
result = can_tile_board(n, board)
print(result)
